definitions.explanation: A secure box or cabinet for storing valuables, typically with a lock.
A secure room or building for storing money or valuables.

notes:
{金庫|きんこ} refers to a secure container or room for storing valuables such as money, documents, and jewelry. It ranges from small household safes to large bank vaults.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金庫|きんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open a safe
- {金庫|きんこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in the safe
- {金庫|きんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧: to close/lock the safe
- ⟦{耐火|たいか}→耐火：noentry⟧{金庫|きんこ}: fireproof safe
- {金庫|きんこ}⟦{破|やぶ}り→破る：02321_yaburu⟧: safe-cracking

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{貸|かし}{金庫|きんこ}→貸金庫：27035_kashikinko⟧: safe deposit box (at a bank)
- {金庫|きんこ}⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧: treasurer, keeper of the safe

FORMS:
{金|きん} (metal, money) + {庫|こ} (storehouse). The kanji {庫|こ} also appears in ⟦{車庫|しゃこ}→車庫：00361_shako⟧ (garage), ⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧ (warehouse).
